inputs.text:
Let's talk about what's really happening when the state tries to brush off the legitimate struggles of the working class. On Thursday, we saw workers employed in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth taking to the streets outside the Presidential Palace, standing up against systemic precarity and demanding basic dignity. They are fighting for legally binding job security guarantees because they refuse to remain trapped in cycles of labor exploitation. 

Predictably, the government is trying to dodge accountability, claiming they have already delivered on the most significant demands. But we know how this story goes—those in power always want to silence marginalized workers with empty promises instead of structural reform. That is why these workers have announced a 24-hour strike. Solidarity with the frontline workers demanding justice against institutional neglect!
